name: radio-group
useFor: Use for one choice among two to five options that should all stay visible (a card type, a spending period). Pair each item with a Label variant="control". Give the root a name to submit with FormData; use a select for longer lists and a segmented control for a compact toolbar choice.
constraints: A radio for an action that happens at once
Colors other than blue for the chosen state
source: Extrapolated from agentcard-website src/app/globals.css (the checkbox's --bevel-muted and --bevel-blue keys)
title: Radio Group
description: Round small keys for one choice from a short list; the chosen one is the blue key with a white dot.
